{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate on patient_id by keeping the row with the highest sample_seq per patient
deduplicated_data = data.loc[data.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Now compute the fraction of patients with severe baseline disease
total_patients = len(deduplicated_data)
severe_patients = deduplicated_data['severity'].eq('severe').sum()
fraction_severe = severe_patients / total_patients

print(f'Total deduplicated patients: {total_patients}')
print(f'Severe baseline disease count: {severe_patients}')
print(f'Fraction with severe baseline disease: {fraction_severe}')"}
